title: SSH Term polls: the definition file (polls/polls.json)
description: Every poll (アンケート) of SSH Term, past and to come. polls/rules.js adds what a schema cannot say: lengths and blanks counted once trimmed, real dates, the deadline after the start, resultsAt at or after the deadline, the announcement's end after resultsAt (after the deadline when there is none), the link's host, unique ids and no two polls open at once.

id.description: The page is /polls/<id>. Lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens; not "index".

options.description: The answers, one of which is chosen.

freeText.description: An optional free text field under the options.

closesAt.description: The deadline; 14 days after opensAt when not given.

resultsAt.description: When the results are published: the counts on the API and the poll's page, the results (14 days) and the announcement in current.json. At or after the deadline. Set it only once the developer has checked the counts; until it is set and reached, nothing about the counts is public.

announcement.description: An optional announcement (お知らせ) that goes with the results.

link.description: https to one of the hosts polls/rules.js allows (LINK_HOSTS, the one list of them), with no userinfo or port.

until.description: When the app and the results page stop showing it; 30 days after resultsAt when not given, and after resultsAt (after the deadline while there is no resultsAt). It shows from the results (resultsAt).

time.description: ISO 8601 with a zone and no fractions of a second, e.g. 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z.

langs.description: A text in the app's languages; en is required and stands in for a missing one.

plain.description: No control characters and none that turn the direction (ADR 0015).
